_purpose: Versioned data contract between the C1 calibration-data lane and the C2 Baxter Rating RMSE harness.
_governance: This document is EXPERIMENTAL. Nothing it points at becomes canonical V3 configuration.
It ships unfilled on purpose: no observation set has been delivered, and inventing a
path or a hash here would give an absent dataset the appearance of provenance.
While observations.path is null the harness returns READY_FOR_DATA and no metrics.
C1 fills observations.*, split_policy and hfa; C3 fills witnesses. Neither may add a
column outside the governed observation allowlist, and betting-flow and injury signals

metric._note: Operational definition proposed by the C2 harness. Ruling R2-CAL-OBJECTIVE names Baxter Rating RMSE as the primary criterion but does not state its formula, so this definition is DERIVED and is not admissible as promotion evidence until a ruling adopts it.

hfa._note: Deferred to governed V3 configuration so the harness carries no copy of a governed value. Set points only alongside source=CONTRACT_LITERAL.

notes: Independent witnesses are reported beside the primary criterion and are never blended into it.
Holdout is scored only in a single-regime confirmation run.
No candidate calibration values are authored by this contract or by the harness.
